text: M52 `qtq9iusb` says every confirmation write from the #skills card carries all names confirmed according to the list, and that the current project has no row on the list; M31 `naxqsfra` says the write replaces the stored list whole. Not stated: what happens to a stored confirmation of the project's OWN exposed name (`skill.name`), e.g. one written by `c4s confirm-skill-uses` or before a rename. It has no row, so the card cannot carry it, and the next card write drops it. Keeping it would need either a row for the current project or a server-side merge, both against the pages as written. Assumed: the drop is accepted — the own name resolves as `self` before any confirmation check, so no attachment status changes. If the specification wants the own confirmation kept, it should say how the card learns it (e.g. a field on the list response) or allow the write to keep names the list does not show.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-6910 — a stored confirmation of the project's own exposed name is not carried by a card write (it has no row on the list) and is dropped; the own name resolves as `self`, so no attachment status changes.
